info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Payments Payments Methods-v3-spec
info.description: The Payment Methods API provides access to a comprehensive list of available payment methods for processing transactions. It allows developers to retrieve information about each method’s attributes, enabling seamless integration of various payment options into applications. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms, payment gateways, and financial service providers who need to enhance their transaction capabilities. This API is essential for ensuring that users can select from an array of payment options to facilitate their purchases efficiently.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve a list of available payment methods that can be utilized for transactions. Use this information to enhance customer experience by providing them with various options for payment.

requestBody.description: Request payload for retrieving payment methods. This should include any filters or configurations needed to specify which payment methods to return.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of available payment methods.
